name: jairf-ui-icons
description: JAIRF UI/2D icon & HUD roadmap (per 04_UI_Icon_HUD_List.md). Core HUD (health/mana/XP bars, minimap, quest tracker, target frames, buffs, hotbar, chat, party), inventory & items (slots, rarity borders, currency, equipment, categories), skills & classes, builder mode UI (toolbar, snap, filters, save/share/publish, validation errors), social/multiplayer, system & menus, feedback/status icons (damage types, CC, objectives, interaction prompts). Style: consistent line weight, high contrast, color-coded, PNG + alpha, Sprite Atlas.

phases.name: 7. Style pass + export (atlases, contrast, PNG transparency)
